address: 132 boulevard de la Rochelle, Bar-le-Duc, 55000, France
bio: This ex-grocer’s shop is now a contemporary bistro, rich in flavour and colour, that hits the spot every time. The owner, son of a pastry chef, rustles up market-fresh cuisine in tune with the seasons, like this slow-cooked pork belly with baby onions and braising juices. Respect for the ingredients is the motto. Efficient, unobtrusive staff....
